title: The Ledger of Ashcombe
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: August Blackwood, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
